resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO

access.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT code with NEB capabilities (pw.x + neb.x).

resources.notes: Used for all DFT total-energy, electronic structure, and CI-NEB calculations.

resources.name: PAW pseudopotentials (PSLibrary / SSSP)

access.notes: Pseudopotentials for Ni, Co, Fe, Mn, as well as the additional metals used in the universality set (e.g., Cu, V, Fe, Ti, Zn, Al, Ta, W).

resources.notes: Must be PAW-PBE type to match the paper's computational setup.

resources.name: Atomic Simulation Environment (ASE)

access.notes: Python library for structure manipulation and supercell generation. Can be used to create SQS or SAE-like supercells.

resources.notes: Optional; the agent may use other methods (e.g., ATAT) to generate supercells.
